title: Graded JSON Mode Degradation & Compatibility Smoke Suite
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a compact, CI-friendly smoke test suite that exercises progressive JSON-mode degradation scenarios, a compatibility adapter that normalizes loose outputs into the current schema, and constrained-decoding enforcement checks. The goal is to catch regressions introduced by model changes, streaming behaviour, or SDK compatibility layers before they reach runtime customers. This ticket focuses on test design, harness implementation, and initial CI integration (thresholds + gating).
acceptance_criteria: A reducible smoke suite of ~30 scenarios implemented in the tests harness (unit/CI friendly)
Scenarios cover: clean strict-json, partial-stream fragments, trailing garbage recovery, type-variant fields (string vs object), and adapter normalization of legacy shapes
A compatibility adapter shim that can transform three legacy output patterns into canonical schema with declarative mapping rules and unit tests
CI metric thresholds: parsing_success_rate >= 98% on stable model baseline, adapter_repair_rate >= 95% for legacy patterns, and <0.5% increase in average latency under streaming mode
Tests integrated into PR gate with clear failure messages and remediation hints (link to runbook)
Documentation page that describes test scenarios, how to add new cases, and trade-offs between strict vs soft enforcement
test_matrix: STRICT-CLEAN: full JSON objects streamed in multiple chunks; expect immediate parse success at stream end
PARTIAL-TRAILING: valid object followed by random token noise in stream; expect parser to ignore trailing garbage or flag with recoverable error depending on mode
FRAGMENT-RECOVERY: deliberately cut JSON mid-token across chunk boundaries; expect robust reassembly and parse success
TYPE-SWITCH: field 'metadata' sometimes emitted as string, sometimes as object; adapter should coerce string->object with stable mapping
LEGACY-ARRAY-WRAP: older models wrap response in top-level array; adapter should unwrap into canonical object
MISSING-OPTIONALS: optional fields omitted in ~20% of cases; schema adherence check should pass if optionals are absent
EXTRA-UNKNOWN-FIELDS: models emit additional keys; enforcement mode should allow unknowns in 'permissive' mode and fail in 'strict' mode
FUNCTION-CALL-INTERLEAVE: tool-calling tokens interleaved with structured output; ensure decoder still extracts final JSON payload
QUANTIZED-SYNTAX-GLITCH: simulate tokenization anomalies (e.g., truncated unicode) to observe parser resilience
CONCURRENT-BURST: run 200 parallel streaming sessions to validate latency and parser memory bounds
steps: Design mapping rules for compatibility adapter (three common legacy shapes identified from telemetry)
Implement small adapter module in rust/py (mirror existing runtime language) with unit tests
Extend the constrained-decoder test harness to accept streaming chunk fixtures and expected canonical output
Add smoke scenarios to CI pipeline (parallel shard that runs quick cases) and threshold assertions
Instrument telemetry for parsing_success_rate and adapter_repair_rate; wire to console-dashboard
Write runbook for remediation when suite fails (how to triage: model, runtime, or adapter)
Demo results to runtime and SDK owners and capture feedback
